title: recover-Q: two GT logarithms with the plain-track STNFS core (plain P20): 119.169169632701

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, proof.md's algorithm (section 1 reduction with the field map of field-map.md, then the STNFS GT core of proof.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md and STORAGE.md) returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P (Q=[a]Q0; z=1 handled directly) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5, and all classical work is at most 2^119.169169632701 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions): the core's global meter 2^119.1691696327 (proof.md section 8: collection <= 2^118.895525055, linear algebra <= 2^116.481352797 (seven owners; |c| in {2,3,4} as |c| unit entries, PREREG-K; 64-bit left Block Wiedemann vectors, failure <= 0.0244555 charged in success), both logarithms metered at 2^113.303) plus the wrapper (pairing, field map, scalar multiplication, check) <= 2^80 instructions, a 2^66 row. Core success >= 0.44343, >= 0.39 at +10% expected descent work; with the wrapper >= 0.44343 - 2^-48. Analytic exploratory claim.
